NAV_BUILDER
info:
# UI Builder Subflow

Takes `msg.rbac` (from the RBAC subflow output 1) and builds
role-scoped HTML snippets for tiles, sidebar nav, and JS redirect
listeners ready to drop into a Mustache template.

## Environment variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `ICON_BASE` | `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/coppercloud-iotech/staticfiles/artline/` | CDN prefix for all icon URLs |

## Output msg properties

| Property | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `msg.homeButtons` | HTML string — tile grid for the home page |
| `msg.navButtons` | HTML string — sidebar nav buttons |
| `msg.redirectListeners` | JS string — `addRedirectListener(...)` calls |

## Wiring

```
[RBAC subflow output 1] → [UI Builder input]
[UI Builder output 1]   → [Template / DB node]
```

RBAC_MIDDLEWARE
info:
Role-Based Access Control middleware.

Wire AUTH_MIDDLEWARE output 3 → into this subflow.

Set ALLOWED_ROLES on each instance:
  admin                  → admin only
  admin,manager          → admin + manager
  admin,manager,operator → all roles

Outputs:
  1 → Authorised           → go to template / DB
  2 → Fetch denied (403)   → wire to http response
  3 → Browser denied (302) → wire to http response
